Meera Shah: Quick org note — we9re launching an Embedded Customer Success Engineering stream to better support Dedicated/Private deployments. Anya Patel is joining as Director, Embedded CSE and starts Tue Jun 1. Welcome Anya! :tada:

Meera Shah: The stream will be carved out of CS-Platform. Embedded CSE will own customer integration playbooks, private deployment on-call, and deep technical onboarding. Platform-facing CS infra remains with Lizzy. This is a reallocation of existing reqs (no additional headcount this quarter).

Anya Patel: Excited to join. I9ll post a 60/90 plan by Friday and schedule a weekly triage with Platform.

Lizzy Mendoza: Congrats Anya! Agreed escalation goes to me for platform changes (cc Anya). I9ll add the observability checklist to the hiring doc.

Evan Carter: For hiring loops: recommend 1 runtime troubleshooting question + 1 architecture deep-dive. I can own the panel once owners are nominated.

Meera Shah: Q2 hiring priorities (reallocated): 2 Senior Embedded CSE, 1 Staff SWE (integration), 1 TPM. Recruiting, please post reqs and attach interview rubric today.

Recruiting Bot: Created REQ-5010, REQ-5011 (Sr Embedded CSE), REQ-5012 (Staff SWE), REQ-5013 (TPM). Owners: Anya (5010/5011/5013), Lizzy (5012). Panel owner: Evan Carter. Interview kit attached.

Ash Sinha: People-ops note: comp bands may need a small uplift (~5-8%) due to on-call and travel. We9ll fast-track approvals; please ensure scorecards are ready before interviews.

Meera Shah: Action items:
- Recruiting: JD + post (today)
- Anya: 60/90 plan + weekly sync (this week)
- Hiring owners: nominate interviewers by Thu EOD
- People-ops: finalize comp guidance by Fri

Anya Patel: Will do. Happy to take 1:1 intros.

Meera Shah: Thanks all 3 keep updates in this thread; we9ll send a cross-org announcement after first hires are onboarded.
